reason: Conversation 1 stayed focused on the fridge fan and ice, backed up the defrost advice with a simple checks sequence, and added practical preparation (photo of the display, towels, drain channel). It then answered the escalation question directly: contact Samsung authorised service, quote the model and 22E, check the warranty route, and give a ready-made description of the symptoms. Conversation 2 was also correct and safe, covering the defrost, no hairdryer, and not removing panels, but it spent its second turn conditioned on the appliance being out of warranty, a point the customer had not settled, and gave less concrete guidance on who to contact and how to describe the fault. Conversation 1 did include some less useful steps, such as the door-switch fan test the customer could not interpret, but this was a minor drawback.
